title: 80% of Netflix Users Have Watched Korean Content
paragraphs: Korean TV shows and movies have become very popular around the world. Now, Netflix says that more than 80% of its members worldwide have watched something from Korea.
Netflix shared this number to celebrate ten years of doing business in South Korea. It also held a fan festival called "Netflix Janchi" in Seoul on October 24 and 25, 2026.

According to Netflix, Korean content is now the most-watched content on the service that is not in English. Between April 2025 and March 2026, people spent more than 12 billion hours watching Korean shows and movies. Only content made in the US was watched more.

The most famous Korean show on Netflix is "Squid Game." The first season stayed in Netflix's Global Top 10 for 32 weeks in a row, which is a record. Since June 2021, more than 200 Korean shows and movies have appeared in the Global Top 10.

Korean content also seems to make people interested in Korean culture. According to Netflix, people who have watched Korean content are much more likely to want to visit Korea. Some places where shows were filmed have become popular with tourists. More people are also learning the Korean language. For example, in the US, the number of new Korean learners on the language app Duolingo rose by 37% during the week that the third season of "Squid Game" came out.
Netflix has worked with more than 80 production companies in Korea, and more than 25,000 actors and crew members have worked on its Korean productions.
Ted Sarandos, a co-CEO of Netflix, said that for Netflix, Korea is more than a market.
